joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#Hall_MB).multiButton_button1 != "pushed")
triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_MB).multiButton_button1 == "pushed")
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(min((#Hall_Light).light_currentBrightness + 10, 100), 0)
triggered = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 멀티버튼의 버튼1이 눌릴 때마다 복도 조명 밝기를 10씩 높여줘. 최대 100까지.
command_eng: Each time button 1 of the multi-button is pressed, increase the hallway light brightness by 10, up to a maximum of 100.
